meta.title: Road · yokoten
meta.description: The five stages of the yokoten road, then the desk and the kanban. Every step is listed in the docs.

intro.label: The road
intro.title: What happens after day one
intro.body: Day one is the safety net. After that, yokoten walks your project through how good teams work, one step at a time. You can say "not now" to any step.

stages.label: Five stages
stages.title: Five stages, one step at a time

desk.label: The desk
desk.title: One task, one AI, one fence
desk.body: An AI agent works inside a fence around its own copy of a folder: it writes only there, and your other files stay hidden.

kanban.label: The kanban
kanban.title: The whole line on one board
kanban.body: A preview in v0.1.2: `yokoten kanban --text` shows each session and its state, the pull requests that wait on you, and the health of Actions. It only reads; the page in your browser comes next.
